policies.name: budget-guard
policies.description: Minimize spend while keeping quality acceptable across all tasks. Caps per-call cost and demands a modest quality floor, then ranks survivors mostly on cost with a light quality tie-breaker.

explanations.headline: route "classify-intent" to harbor-mini (score 0.8157)
reasons: harbor-mini beat runner-up lighthouse-local by a margin of 0.0698 in weighted score
evidence: replayed 70 recorded call(s): 97.1% success, mean quality 0.908, mean latency 259 ms, total cost $12.9234
versus cheapest-model baseline harbor-nano: $7.5293 more cost, 0.908 vs 0.778 mean quality

policies.name: privacy-lockdown
policies.description: Restricted data must never leave on-premise infrastructure. Caps privacy at internal and clears only the on-prem model to handle stricter tiers; ranks on quality then reliability.

violations.detail: task data reaches "confidential" but policy caps at "internal" and model is not privacy-safe
